name: optisigns
description: Design digital signage content and publish it to OptiSigns screens: slides, menu boards, kiosk pages and dashboards, with playlists, schedules and screen management.

interface.longDescription: OptiSigns turns screens into digital signs. This plugin helps you design content that reads well on a screen across the room (slides, menu boards, announcements, kiosk pages and dashboards), then publishes it to your OptiSigns account: upload, add to a playlist, schedule it and put it on the right screens. It also answers questions about OptiSigns setup, devices and best practices, and helps you keep screens organized.
defaultPrompt: What can OptiSigns do for my screens?
Design a lunch special slide and put it on my Front Counter screen
Show this week's announcements on the lobby screen Mon-Fri 8-5

positive.description: List the account's screens and what each one is showing.
positive.prompt: Which screens do I have in OptiSigns, and what is each one showing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the screens in the demo account by name, including the screen named Lobby, with the content currently assigned to each. The screen may be offline; online status is not part of this check.

positive.description: Build a playlist from existing images in the media library.
positive.prompt: Create a playlist called Lobby Loop with all the images in my OptiSigns library.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a playlist named Lobby Loop containing the demo account's sample images and confirms the playlist name and item count.

positive.description: Assign a playlist to a named screen.
positive.prompt: Show the Lobby Loop playlist on my Lobby screen.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Lobby screen and the Lobby Loop playlist, assigns the playlist to the screen, and confirms Lobby is now set to Lobby Loop. The screen may be offline; it plays the playlist the next time it connects, and the assignment is visible in the first and last test cases.

positive.description: Create a recurring weekday schedule that plays a playlist.
positive.prompt: Create a schedule called Weekday Mornings that plays Lobby Loop from 8 to 11 AM, Monday to Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a schedule named Weekday Mornings with one item that plays Lobby Loop 8:00-11:00 AM on weekdays, and confirms the days and times.

positive.description: Find where a playlist is used.
positive.prompt: Where is the Lobby Loop playlist being used?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the screens and schedules that use Lobby Loop, including the Lobby screen and the Weekday Mornings schedule if the earlier cases were run.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the user's OptiSigns account; the app should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Signage design advice that needs no account data; the app should not be called.
negative.prompt: What font size should I use for a menu board read from 3 meters away?

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about a digital sign in a coffee shop.
